bias_targets.methodology: Fine-tuning GPT models on age-biased datasets (young and old) and evaluating the generated responses through a human user survey that rates perceived bias on a 1 to 10 scale.
Fine-tuning GPT models on gender-biased datasets (male and female) and evaluating the generated responses through a human user survey that rates perceived bias on a 1 to 10 scale.
Fine-tuning GPT models on race-biased datasets (Asian, White, Black, and Australoid) and evaluating the generated responses through a human user survey that rates perceived bias on a 1 to 10 scale.
